m: श्ना (in gram.) a technical term for the affix ना (the characteristic sign of the 9th class of verbs).
a: श्ना — A technical term used by Pāṇini for ना, the sign of the 9th class of ruts.

m: श्नाभाश्नौष्टीय n. du. N. of two Sāmans (cf. श्नौष्ट below), ĀrṣBr.
श्नौष्टी-गव n. N. of a Sāman, ib.
श्नौष्ट n. (fr. prec.) N. of various Sāmans (cf. श्नभाश्नौष्टीय above), ĀrṣBr.

श्नथ् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xix, 37) श्नथति (only occurring in pr. Subj. श्नथत्, Impv. श्नथिहि, and aor. श्नथिष्टम्, ˚टन; Gr. also pf. शश्नाथ; fut. श्नथिता, ˚थिष्यति &c.), to pierce, strike, injure, kill, RV. : Caus. श्नथयति, ˚ते (aor. अशिश्नत्, शिश्नथत्) id., ib. : Desid. शिश्नथिषति Gr.: Intens. शाश्नथ्यते, शाश्नत्ति, ib.
श्नथितृ m. a piercer, killer, slayer, ib.
श्नम् (in gram.) a technical term for the verbal affix न (inserted in roots of the 7th class).
a: श्नम् — A technical term used by Pāṇini for न, the sign of the 7th class of roots.

m: श्नप्त्र (VS.) or श्न्यप्त्र (TS.) n. the corner of the mouth (Mahīdh.)
श्नु (in gram.) a technical term for the affix नु (added to the root in the 5th class of verbs).
a: श्नु — A technical term used by Pāṇini for नु, the sign of the 5th class of roots.

m: श्नुष्टि f. (prob.) either ‘a little heap’ or ‘a small measure’ (for measuring grain), Kāṭh.
श्नुष्टि m. N. of an Āṅgirasa, PañcavBr.
